people.name: Confucius
people.role: 儒家至聖，稱閔子騫之言必中
people.bio_en: Chinese teacher associated with the Analects and the Confucian tradition. Zhongni is his courtesy name.

people.name: Yan Ying
people.role: 齊相，言己事三君而順，非己有三心，乃三君一心
people.bio_en: Statesman of Qi in the Spring and Autumn period. The received anecdotes portray him advising successive rulers.

people.name: The Yellow Emperor
people.role: 中央土德之帝，守脾胃司中細之衛
people.bio_en: Legendary ruler of Chinese antiquity. Daoist texts also associate him with cosmology and the cultivation of the body.

people.name: Yi Yin
people.role: 商湯之賢相，佐湯伐夏，說太甲以明德
people.bio_en: Minister traditionally credited with assisting Tang in establishing the Shang dynasty. Received accounts make him a model of political counsel.

people.name: Guan Zhong
people.role: 齊相，輔桓公霸諸侯，相齊有三歸，奢侈逾制
people.bio_en: Statesman of Qi associated with Duke Huan. Later writings connect his name with statecraft and debates about government.

people.name: Five Mountains True Lords
people.role: 五嶽之神，稟受上清之炁，主奠地土
people.bio_en: Collective designation for mountain deities in Daoist religious literature. They are figures of ritual cosmology rather than a single historical person.
people.name_en: Wu yue zhen ren (Perfected Ones of the Five Sacred Mountains)

people.name: Bo Yi
people.role: 孤竹君子，餓死首陽，不畏重誅不利重賞，是無益之臣；與叔齊同道殉名
people.bio_en: Figure of early Chinese moral tradition, paired with Shuqi. Accounts of his refusal to serve the Zhou make him an example in debates over loyalty and withdrawal.

people.name: Bole
people.role: 善相馬者，以種種法制治馬；亦善教所憎者相千里馬
people.bio_en: Renowned judge of horses in Chinese literary tradition. Stories about him explore discernment, training, and the recognition of talent.

people.name: Duke of Zhou
people.role: 周公旦，為武王病設三壇共一墠，卜以祈福
people.bio_en: Early Zhou statesman traditionally credited with establishing institutions and ritual norms. Received texts present him as a model of loyal service.

people.name: Duke Jing of Qi
people.role: 齊國君主，以季孟之間禮待孔子
people.bio_en: Ruler of Qi during the Spring and Autumn period. The corpus includes accounts of his dealings with Confucius and his advisers.

people.name: Zhong Hang Yue
people.role: 漢宦者，被迫使匈奴而降之，教疏記之法難漢使
people.bio_en: Han envoy who entered Xiongnu service. The received account portrays him advising the Xiongnu on relations with the Han court.

people.name: Bo Ya
people.role: 善鼓琴者，鍾子期死而破弦絕響；操弦謹慎無煩手之累
people.bio_en: Musician of Chinese literary tradition, celebrated for playing the qin. His friendship with Zhong Ziqi became a model of mutual understanding.

people.name: Bo Qin
people.role: 周公旦之子，受封於魯，東伐淮夷，傳治國要道
people.bio_en: Son of the Duke of Zhou and traditional first ruler of Lu. Received accounts associate him with the founding of Lu and instructions on government.

people.name: King Wu of Zhou
people.role: 周武王，周公為其病設三壇祈福
people.bio_en: Zhou ruler associated with the defeat of the Shang. He appears in accounts of the dynasty's founding and of the Duke of Zhou's service.

people.name: Sima Xiangru
people.role: 辭賦大家，嘗至臨邛赴宴，一坐盡傾
people.bio_en: Han writer known for fu, or rhapsodic prose-poetry. The corpus includes the literary account of his relationship with Zhuo Wenjun.

people.name: Mozi
people.role: 墨家創始人，提出三表法以別言論是非，批判不恤民苦之統治者
people.bio_en: Early Chinese thinker associated with the Mohist tradition. The writings bearing his name discuss ethical conduct, government, and standards for judging claims.

people.name: Duke Wen of Jin
people.role: 晉國之君，避驪姬之難，流亡十九年，歸而立，是為晉文公
people.bio_en: Ruler of Jin in the Spring and Autumn period. Received histories recount his years in exile and subsequent rise to power.

people.name: Emperor Wen of Han
people.role: 漢孝文皇帝，從代來即位，宮室狗馬無所增益，節儉愛民
people.bio_en: Han emperor remembered in received histories for restraint in expenditure and government. He came to the throne after ruling Dai.

people.name: King Wen of Zhou
people.role: 周文王，丕顯文王之謨
people.bio_en: Preconquest Zhou ruler celebrated in Chinese political and ritual tradition. Later texts treat his conduct as a model of virtuous rule.

people.name: Duke Huan of Qi
people.role: 齊桓公，不能用管仲之言，卒近用易牙、豎刀、開方以致禍
people.bio_en: Ruler of Qi associated with the minister Guan Zhong. Accounts of his reign contrast successful counsel with the influence of court favorites.

people.name: Emperor Wu of Han
people.role: 漢武帝，立皇子閎、旦、胥為王，各有申誡
people.bio_en: Han emperor whose reign appears in accounts of imperial government, military affairs, and court life. The corpus includes instructions addressed to his princely sons.

people.name: Gongsun Long
people.role: 魏賢公子，好與賢人游，悅公孫龍之學
people.bio_en: Aristocratic figure in the received philosophical anecdotes. He is depicted as interested in the teachings of Gongsun Long; he is not Gongsun Long himself.

people.name: Zhu Fu Yan
people.role: 漢武帝時大臣，嘗相齊，窮治後宮，致齊王懼誅飲藥
people.bio_en: Official under Emperor Wu of Han. The received account connects him with political affairs and an investigation at the court of Qi.

people.name: Chou Mu
people.role: 宋國大夫，不畏強禦，聞難而至，手劍叱宋萬，遂遇害
people.bio_en: Official of Song in the Spring and Autumn period. Received accounts describe his death while confronting Song Wan during a political crisis.

people.name: Zhongshan Fu
people.role: 周宣王之賢臣，尹吉甫詩中所美者也
people.bio_en: Minister associated with King Xuan of Zhou. He is praised in a poem attributed to Yin Jifu.

people.name: Fu Xi
people.role: 伏羲始造六法，調陰陽、合天道，天下化之；又造駕辯之曲
people.bio_en: Legendary culture hero, also written Fuxi in other Chinese character forms. Received traditions associate him with the origins of institutions, music, and cosmological order.

people.name: Bo Cheng Zigao
people.role: 辭諸侯而耕，堯治天下不賞而民勸，禹治天下賞罰而民不仁，德自此衰
people.bio_en: Recluse in early Chinese philosophical literature. The story of his withdrawal from office contrasts different models of government and moral influence.

people.name: Shu Qi
people.role: 孤竹君子，與伯夷同上首陽，不食周粟而死
people.bio_en: Figure of early Chinese moral tradition, paired with Boyi. Their refusal to serve the Zhou is discussed in accounts of loyalty and withdrawal.

people.name: Empress Lü
people.role: 漢高祖后，惠帝母，斷戚夫人手足，號曰人彘，臨朝稱制
people.bio_en: Empress of the early Han and mother of Emperor Hui. Received histories describe her exercise of political power and the violence of court rivalries.

people.name: Yao
people.role: 古聖王，上不及堯下不為桀紂
people.bio_en: Legendary sage ruler of Chinese antiquity. Traditions of his rule and succession became reference points in debates about good government.

people.name: Sun Shu'ao
people.role: 楚令尹，三任相位而不喜，知材之自得
people.bio_en: Minister of Chu in the Spring and Autumn period. Philosophical anecdotes portray his composure in accepting and losing office.

people.name: Song Wan
people.role: 宋國大夫，弒閔公
people.bio_en: Official of Song in the Spring and Autumn period. Received histories connect him with the killing of the ruler of Song.

people.name: King Xuan of Zhou
people.role: 西周天子，廢申后立襃姒
people.bio_en: Royal title identified in the source index with King Xuan of Zhou. The accompanying description appears to conflate different Zhou rulers, so the identification requires review.

people.name: Ji Fu
people.role: 周宣王賢臣，詩美仲山甫
people.bio_en: Minister associated with King Xuan of Zhou. Received tradition credits him with poetry praising Zhongshanfu.

people.name: Prince Guangling
people.role: 漢武帝子，封廣陵王，策命誡以慎外不作威福
people.bio_en: Princely title here assigned to a son of Emperor Wu of Han. The corpus includes an imperial admonition about the exercise of power.

people.name: King Hui of Liang
people.role: 戰國時魏君，以移民移粟喻王道
people.bio_en: Ruler of Wei, also called Liang, during the Warring States period. Dialogues in the Mencius place him in discussions of humane government.

people.name: Prince Yan
people.role: 漢武帝子，封燕王，策命誡以慎內無怨德
people.bio_en: Princely title here assigned to a son of Emperor Wu of Han. The corpus includes instructions on his conduct as a ruler.

people.name: Tian Heng
people.role: 齊之俠士，恥於臣漢，島居自守，卒伏劍死
people.bio_en: Leader from Qi during the transition from Qin to Han. Received histories recount his refusal to submit and the loyalty of his followers.

people.name: Dao Zhi
people.role: 柳下季之弟，橫行天下，暴亂之人
people.bio_en: Outlaw figure in early Chinese literary and philosophical tradition. Stories bearing his name question conventional judgments of virtue and success.

people.name: Ji
people.role: 周的始祖，與伯夷、禹並稱三后，成功於民
people.bio_en: Ancestral figure of the Zhou in Chinese tradition, associated with agriculture. Received texts credit him with service to the people.

people.name: Guan Zi
people.role: 論治世七法之書名
people.bio_en: Title of a composite collection of writings on government and economic affairs, traditionally associated with Guan Zhong. This source-index entry denotes a book rather than a separate person.

people.name: Shun
people.role: 古帝，持中不懈，上應天心，降於堯而成王業
people.bio_en: Legendary sage ruler of Chinese antiquity. Accounts of his selection by Yao and his conduct in office illustrate ideals of moral government.

people.name: Xunzi
people.role: 儒家大師，駁宋子人情欲寡之說，以為人情欲多
people.bio_en: Confucian thinker of the Warring States period. The writings bearing his name examine ritual, learning, human desires, and political order.

people.name: Xiao He
people.role: 漢丞相，遭漢興，依日月末光而興
people.bio_en: Statesman of the early Han. Received histories describe his service in the establishment and administration of the dynasty.

people.name: Zou Yan
people.role: 戰國時陰陽家，倡五德終始之說
people.bio_en: Warring States thinker associated with yin-yang thought and the succession of the Five Phases. Later accounts preserve reports of his doctrines.

people.name: Zhong Ziqi
people.role: 伯牙知音，期死而伯牙破弦
people.bio_en: Listener celebrated in the story of the musician Boya. Their friendship became an emblem of someone who understands another person's intentions.

people.name: Yan Yuan
people.role: 孔子弟子，好學不遷怒不貳過
people.bio_en: Disciple of Confucius, also known as Yan Yuan. The Analects presents him as devoted to learning and moral cultivation.

people.name: Liu Xiu
people.role: 一元者，萬物之本源，隱蔽無名之大道
people.bio_en: Expression for an originating principle in the indexed passage. The source does not establish a historical person behind it.

people.name: Ding Lingwei
people.role: 遼束人，少學仙道，分身變化為鶴，集郡城華表柱而歌
people.bio_en: Figure in Daoist tales of transcendents. His story associates Liaodong with a return in the form of a crane, a literary motif rather than a documented event.

people.name: Ding Shuying
people.role: 有救窮陰德，度人急難，上感皇人，授道要，為朱陵嬪
people.bio_en: Female figure in Daoist hagiography. The indexed account praises her aid to people in distress and relates her reception of religious teachings.

people.name: Hu Gong
people.role: 惠公所殺七大夫之總名
people.bio_en: Collective designation for seven officials of Jin in received historical accounts. Their deaths are associated with Duke Hui; the Zuo Tradition and Discourses of the States list their names.
people.name_en: Qi yu da fu (The Seven Carriage Officials)

people.name: Anonymous Elder
people.role: 丈人送公子，易其事者或有其難在其後
people.bio_en: Anonymous elder in a received anecdote. His warning concerns difficulties that may follow an apparently easy undertaking.

people.name: Goujian
people.role: 丈人笑勾踐，譏其易其事而不悟其難
people.bio_en: An episode label treated as a person by the source index. It refers to an elder's criticism of Goujian rather than establishing a separate named individual.
people.name_en: Zhang ren xiao Goujian (The Elder Who Laughed at Goujian)

people.name: Zhang Sanfeng
people.role: 道家隱仙，丹經詩文之所出
people.bio_en: Daoist figure associated with inner alchemy and later religious lineages. A collection of writings is transmitted under his name; his life is surrounded by later legend.

people.name: Wei Qing's son Buyi
people.role: 衛青之子，與兄弟同日封侯
people.bio_en: Son of the Han general Wei Qing. The indexed account places his enfeoffment alongside those of his brothers.

people.name: Lord of Qielan
people.role: 且蘭國君，反漢遂誅之置牂柯郡
people.bio_en: Unnamed ruler of Qielan in the received Han historical account. The passage concerns resistance to Han expansion and the establishment of a commandery.

people.name: Zhong Qi
people.role: 秦昭王時哲士，借知伯之事戒昭王審度時勢
people.bio_en: Speaker in an anecdote set at the court of King Zhao of Qin. He invokes the fate of Zhi Bo when discussing political judgment.

people.name: Zhong Hang Wenzi
people.role: 晉臣，受人之惠振己過而出亡
people.bio_en: Jin statesman in the received anecdotes. The indexed story concerns his exile and the treatment of those who had criticized him.

people.name: Gong Meng
people.role: 晉大夫，帥師伐狄圍鼓，不受叛城以德服人
people.bio_en: Jin commander in the received historical account. The indexed passage portrays his rejection of a city's betrayal in a campaign against Gu.

people.name: Zhong Du
people.role: 晉邑，孔子為之中都宰
people.bio_en: Place name entered in the source's person index. It is associated there with an administrative appointment of Confucius, not with a named individual.

people.name: Dan Zhu
people.role: 帝堯之子，以德選賢禪位於舜
people.bio_en: Son of the legendary ruler Yao in received tradition. Accounts of the succession contrast his position by birth with Shun's selection for virtue.

people.name: Jiu Fang Yan
people.role: 戰國時相馬之士，精於形法觀人
people.bio_en: Horse judge in received philosophical literature. The indexed story uses his discernment to distinguish outward appearance from underlying qualities.

people.name: Jiu Fang Gao
people.role: 戰國時相馬之士，能超形取神
people.bio_en: Horse judge celebrated in a story about looking beyond external features. His name belongs to the literary tradition of discerning talent.

people.name: Liao Ran Zi
people.role: 遼東人，出入虎豹，周遊三楚百餘年
people.bio_en: Figure in Daoist hagiography associated with Liaodong and journeys through southern China. Reports of his extraordinary longevity belong to that religious narrative.

people.name: Five Emperor Deities
people.role: 五臟之帝各稟其炁，充於極陰之宮
people.bio_en: Daoist cosmological expression associated with the body's organs. The indexed term denotes powers or qi rather than a historical individual.
people.name_en: Wu di zhi qi (The Qi of the Five Emperors)

people.name: Five Emperor Names
people.role: 五帝各有元名煞鬼，書名以消魔障
people.bio_en: Designation in a Daoist ritual passage concerning divine names and protective powers. Its treatment as a person in the source index requires review.
people.name_en: Wu di yuan ming sha gui

people.name: Five Emperor Governance Precepts
people.role: 五帝養氣體而不乞言，有善則記之
people.bio_en: A phrase from the Book of Rites describing the Five Emperors' emulation of elders' conduct. It is a clause in a discussion of care for the aged, not a person's name.

people.name: Five Emperor Direct Messenger Ghosts
people.role: 五帝直符之鬼，述其名以闢邪
people.bio_en: Collective designation for spirit messengers in a Daoist ritual text. These are figures of religious cosmology rather than documented historical people.

people.name: Tian Heng's Five Hundred Followers
people.role: 田橫之徒屬，聞橫死皆自殺
people.bio_en: Collective designation for followers of Tian Heng. Received histories relate their deaths after learning of his death.

people.name: Kang Cang Zi
people.role: 姓庚桑名楚，陳人，得老君道，能以耳視而目聽
people.bio_en: Daoist figure identified in the received tradition with Gengsang Chu. Stories about him explore learning and perception through accounts of exceptional abilities.

people.name: Chou Sheng
people.role: 湯時木正，食松脂，三十餘年而更壯，人咸師奉之
people.bio_en: Figure in Daoist hagiography, set in the time of Tang of Shang. The tale associates him with pine resin and practices intended to prolong life.

people.name: Jie Zitui
people.role: 晉臣，從重耳流亡，歸國後隱山，不受祿
people.bio_en: Retainer of the future Duke Wen of Jin during his exile. Later tradition celebrates his withdrawal from court and refusal of rewards.

people.name: Reng Shu
people.role: 周大夫，作詩美宣王撥亂反正之志
people.bio_en: Zhou official associated in the received tradition with poetry about royal government. The indexed passage connects him with King Xuan.

people.name: Zhongying
people.role: 公孫嬰齊以兄後而立嗣，故稱仲嬰齊
people.bio_en: Lu aristocrat also called Gongsun Yingqi. The indexed account discusses his succession within the family.

people.name: Zhongshen
people.role: 齊大夫，來聘於魯，魯因以定
people.bio_en: The index appears to combine the name Zhongsun with the verb for coming. The accompanying account describes an envoy from Qi to Lu; the precise personal identification remains uncertain.

people.name: Zhonggong
people.role: 孔子弟子，以德行著稱
people.bio_en: Courtesy name of Ran Yong, a disciple of Confucius. The Analects associates him with moral conduct and the responsibilities of government.

people.name: Zhongyou
people.role: 孔子弟子，子路之字
people.bio_en: Disciple of Confucius commonly known as Zilu. Received accounts portray his directness and interest in service and government.

people.name: Ren Guang
people.role: 上蔡人，善餌丹，賣於都裏，積八十九年猶故時任光，後不知所終
people.bio_en: Figure in a Daoist hagiographic account, associated with Shangcai. The narrative concerns elixir practices and claims of longevity.

people.name: Ren Gongzi
people.role: 以大鉤巨緇垂東海，期年不得魚，卒獲大魚而天下震駭
people.bio_en: Figure in a Zhuangzi parable about fishing with an enormous hook. The story contrasts large aims with limited methods and expectations.

people.name: Ren Kejuzhi
people.role: 師向道榮，秘鎮元書，以占卜救人，終無疾而化
people.bio_en: Figure in Daoist religious biography, described as a disciple of Xiang Daorong. The indexed account associates him with divination and aid to others.

people.name: Ren Shi
people.role: 宣曲任氏為督道倉吏，秦敗之時獨窖倉粟，因以起富
people.bio_en: Family in a received account of wealth and economic foresight. The story connects their prosperity with storing grain during the fall of Qin.

people.name: Wei Qing's son Kang
people.role: 衛青之子，與兄弟同日封侯
people.bio_en: Son of the Han general Wei Qing. The source records his enfeoffment together with those of his brothers.

people.name: Yi Ren
people.role: 彼人也，指所思慕之君子賢士，所在者遠而不可即
people.bio_en: Literary expression for a person sought or remembered. The index does not establish a particular historical identity.

people.name: Yi Qi Xuanjie
people.role: 渤海異人，乘黃牝馬，憲宗敬禮，術驗神異，歸還東海
people.bio_en: Figure in Daoist hagiography associated with Bohai and an imperial court. Accounts of unusual powers are features of the transmitted tale.

people.name: Wu She
people.role: 楚臣，直諫輔太子，忤賊臣而囚，卒與子俱死於楚
people.bio_en: Official of Chu and father of Wu Zixu. Received histories connect his imprisonment and death with a conflict at the Chu court.

people.name: Wu Zixu
people.role: 吳臣，輔闔閭破楚，闔閭敗後屬鏤死之，囑抉眼置東門觀越滅吳
people.bio_en: Statesman who left Chu and served Wu. Received histories recount his role in interstate conflict and his eventual death at the Wu court.

people.name: Wu Shang
people.role: 仁孝知死而不逃，與父同赴難，使子胥得以雪恥
people.bio_en: Son of Wu She and brother of Wu Zixu. The received account describes his decision to share his father's fate in Chu.

people.name: Wu Ju
people.role: 楚大夫，論臺榭之美不在土木，在民無害
people.bio_en: Official of Chu in the received historical tradition. The indexed passage attributes to him counsel against building projects that harm the people.

people.name: Bo Shi
people.role: 吳太宰，越滅吳後受誅，以為不忠
people.bio_en: Senior official of Wu in received histories of the conflict with Yue. The corpus presents him in discussions of loyalty and political failure.

people.name: Bo Niu
people.role: 孔子弟子，有疾而孔子痛惜之
people.bio_en: Courtesy name of Ran Geng, a disciple of Confucius. The Analects records Confucius's distress at his illness.

people.name: Ling Lun
people.role: 伶倫造律，樂律之祖
people.bio_en: Legendary figure associated with the origins of musical pitch standards. His role belongs to Chinese accounts of the beginnings of institutions.

people.name: He Hou
people.role: 堯時隱士，蒼梧山修道，舉家上昇
people.bio_en: Recluse in Daoist hagiography, placed in the time of Yao. The story associates his family with cultivation on Mount Cangwu.

people.name: He Zixiao
people.role: 十三仙之一，隱元龜洞為地仙
people.bio_en: Figure in Daoist hagiography associated with a cave retreat. The source presents him within a group of religious transcendents.

people.name: Yu Shishe couple
people.role: 仙人，余氏父女傳之主角
people.bio_en: Couple appearing in a Daoist hagiographic account. Their story belongs to a family narrative of religious cultivation.

people.name: Yu Furen
people.role: 余氏女仙人
people.bio_en: Female figure in Daoist hagiography. The source identifies her within a narrative of religious transcendents.

people.name: Fo Xi
people.role: 中牟宰，以中牟畔，召孔子
people.bio_en: Official associated with Zhongmou in the Analects. The text recounts his invitation to Confucius during a rebellion.

people.name: Lai Ge
people.role: 諂諛順志之人，被委以國政
people.bio_en: Figure in a political anecdote concerning flattering advisers. The indexed passage portrays his appointment to public affairs as a warning about court influence.

people.name: Hou Ying
people.role: 魏隱士，說公子以肉投餒虎
people.bio_en: Recluse from Wei in the received account of Prince Xinling. He provides counsel in a story about military rescue and personal loyalty.

people.name: Hou Kai
people.role: 樓觀道士，入山柄真，禁邪除魅，八十六歲解化
people.bio_en: Daoist associated with Louguan in a religious biography. Accounts of his practices and death belong to the hagiographic tradition.

people.name: Hou Daohua
people.role: 河中道士，修葺殿樑，得丹吞之，斫松飛昇
people.bio_en: Daoist figure associated with Hedong in a hagiographic narrative. The story links temple work, an elixir, and an account of transcendence.

people.name: Cang Gong
people.role: 得太倉公傳黃帝扁鵲脈書，知人死生決嫌疑定可治
people.bio_en: Physician known in the Han historical tradition as Cang Gong. The received biography discusses medical learning, diagnosis, and case histories.

people.name: Gong Liu
people.role: 周先祖，卜宅於京，依之以立朝廷序宗族
people.bio_en: Ancestral figure of the Zhou in received tradition. Poetry associates him with settlement, land, and the organization of his community.

people.name: Gongsun Shi
people.role: 秦臣，挾韓以讒甘茂
people.bio_en: Official of Qin in the received account of Gan Mao. The indexed passage connects him with court rivalry and relations with Han.

people.name: Gongshan Buniu
people.role: 魯大夫，仲嬰齊之本名
people.bio_en: Lu aristocrat also referred to as Zhong Yingqi. The indexed passage concerns his family position and succession.

people.name: Liu Xiang
people.role: 漢儒，校書七略，九流鱗萃
people.bio_en: Han scholar and editor associated with the organization of imperial texts. Collections of historical and moral anecdotes are transmitted under his name.

people.name: Shu Xiang
people.role: 晉大夫，論三人同犯鬻獄之罪，生者當誅，死者當戮
people.bio_en: Jin statesman in the received historical tradition. The indexed passage concerns judicial wrongdoing and the impartial application of punishment.

people.name: Shusun Muzi
people.role: 魯大夫，名豹，執志公正，不以私貨壞公義
people.bio_en: Lu statesman also known as Shusun Bao. Received accounts portray his attention to public duty and opposition to private influence.

people.name: Gugong Danfu
people.role: 周族先祖，清晨驅馬而去
people.bio_en: Ancestor of the Zhou royal house in received tradition. Accounts of his migration became examples in discussions of rulership and community.

people.name: Minister of Agriculture
people.role: 五官之司徒，主司田疇
people.bio_en: Official title in early Chinese institutional vocabulary. The indexed passage associates the office with agricultural affairs; it does not name an individual.

people.name: Minister of Works
people.role: 五官之司空，主司公務
people.bio_en: Official title associated with public works. This index entry denotes an office rather than a particular person.

people.name: Minister of War
people.role: 五官之司馬，主司兵戎
people.bio_en: Official title associated with military affairs. This index entry denotes an office rather than a particular person.

people.name: Xiang Shou
people.role: 秦臣，與公孫奭挾韓議以讒甘茂
people.bio_en: Qin official in the received account of Gan Mao. The passage concerns political rivalry and diplomacy involving Han.

people.name: Wu Qian
people.role: 吳王，七國俱起之主謀也
people.bio_en: Han prince associated with the Rebellion of the Seven States. The source presents him as a principal leader of the uprising.

people.name: Wu Qi
people.role: 戰國時名將，仕魏、楚，推行變法
people.bio_en: Military and political figure of the Warring States period, associated with Wei and Chu. The Wuzi is traditionally attributed to him.

people.name: Zhou Yafu
people.role: 漢將，平定七國之亂者
people.bio_en: Han general associated with suppressing the Rebellion of the Seven States. Received histories discuss his military service and court career.

people.name: Zhou Dunyi
people.role: 道州營道人，理學之祖
people.bio_en: Song thinker associated with the development of Neo-Confucianism. His writings link cosmology with ethical cultivation.

people.name: Shang Yang
people.role: 戰國時法家，佐秦孝公變法
people.bio_en: Warring States reformer associated with Qin. Later accounts connect his name with legal institutions, administrative control, and state strengthening.

people.name: Shi Lei
people.role: 晉大夫，三進及溜以諫
people.bio_en: Jin statesman in the received historical tradition. The indexed anecdote concerns his conduct when offering counsel.

people.name: Shou
people.role: 衞宣公之子，代兄赴死
people.bio_en: Son of Duke Xuan of Wey in received tradition. The indexed story portrays him as attempting to save his brother at the cost of his own life.

people.name: Xiahou Zhan
people.role: 晉代文人，與潘安仁並稱二賢
people.bio_en: Writer of the Western Jin period. Literary accounts associate him with Pan Yue, also known as Pan Anren.

people.name: Celestial Emperor
people.role: 天上之帝，有九品靈方次第
people.bio_en: Divine title in the indexed Daoist text. The passage associates it with graded religious prescriptions rather than a historical ruler.

people.name: Most High True Man
people.role: 仙品之一，宜服天皇靈方
people.bio_en: Religious title in Daoist literature. The indexed passage places it within a hierarchy of cultivation and ritual prescriptions.
people.name_en: Tai shang zhen ren (Most High Perfected One)

people.name: Tai Hao
people.role: 伏羲氏，古帝之一
people.bio_en: Legendary sovereign often associated with Fuxi in received Chinese tradition. His name appears in accounts of ancient cosmological order.

people.name: Meng Sunyang
people.role: 辯士，以一毛、肌膚、肢節之喻反駁禽子
people.bio_en: Speaker in early Chinese philosophical anecdotes. The indexed dialogue examines arguments about bodily integrity and benefit to others.

people.name: Ji Zhu
people.role: 術數之士
people.bio_en: Diviner in the received anecdotal tradition. The source identifies him by his role in discussions of divination and judgment.

people.name: Song Zi
people.role: 戰國学者，以為人情欲寡
people.bio_en: Warring States thinker discussed in the Xunzi. The indexed passage criticizes a position concerning the extent of human desires.

people.name: Duke Xiang of Song
people.role: 春秋時欲霸不行
people.bio_en: Ruler of Song in the Spring and Autumn period. Received histories discuss his unsuccessful pursuit of leadership among the states.

people.name: Minister of the Capital
people.role: 五官之宗伯，主司京師
people.bio_en: Official title in early Chinese institutional vocabulary. This source-index entry denotes an office rather than a particular person.

people.name: Duke Kang of Mi
people.role: 周臣，從穆王游涇上，有三女奔之，不獻於王，卒致密亡
people.bio_en: Ruler of Mi in a received account involving King Mu of Zhou. The narrative treats his actions as an example of political misjudgment.

people.name: Mother of Duke Kang of Mi
people.role: 密康公之母，戒康公以三女必致於王
people.bio_en: Unnamed woman in the received account of Duke Kang of Mi. The story gives her a warning about the political consequences of her son's conduct.
people.name_en: Mother of Duke Kang of Mi

people.name: Shao Hao
people.role: 金天氏，古帝之一
people.bio_en: Legendary sovereign in Chinese accounts of antiquity. He is associated with the designation Jintian in received genealogical traditions.

people.name: Qu Yuan
people.role: 楚之賢臣，懷王時任左徒，遭上官大夫讒毀而見疏，作離騷以怨諷
people.bio_en: Poet and statesman traditionally associated with Chu. The Li sao and other works in the Songs of Chu are transmitted under his name.

people.name: Shi Nan Yaoliao
people.role: 楚勇士，弄丸以解兩難
people.bio_en: Figure associated with Chu in philosophical anecdotes. Stories about his skill and composure explore how to respond to difficult situations.

people.name: Ji Chang
people.role: 湯伐夏，帝命亟絕其嗣，一人不留
people.bio_en: Unresolved headword in the source index. Its accompanying role describes a Shang conquest passage but does not securely identify the named subject.

people.name: King Diyi
people.role: 商代天子，歸妹於周
people.bio_en: Late Shang ruler in received historical tradition. The indexed passage refers to a marriage connection with Zhou.

people.name: Emperor Ku
people.role: 高辛氏，古帝之一
people.bio_en: Legendary ruler of Chinese antiquity, associated with the designation Gaoxin. Received genealogies place him among the ancient sovereigns.

people.name: Emperor Yao
people.role: 陶唐氏，古帝之一，以禪讓聞
people.bio_en: Legendary sage ruler, also called Yao. Traditions of his abdication to Shun illustrate ideals of succession based on merit.

people.name: Emperor Shun
people.role: 有虞氏，古帝之一，受堯禪
people.bio_en: Legendary sage ruler, also called Shun. Received accounts describe his selection by Yao and his exemplary conduct.

people.name: Geng Sang Chu
people.role: 亢倉子之本名
people.bio_en: Daoist figure in the Zhuangzi and later traditions. He is associated with teachings on cultivation and with the name Kangcangzi.

people.name: Guang
people.role: 勇士，射虎誤以石為虎矢沒入石
people.bio_en: Abbreviated name in an anecdote about an archer mistaking a stone for a tiger. The headword alone does not securely establish the person's full identity.

people.name: Zhang Zai
people.role: 宋儒，太和之說
people.bio_en: Song Confucian thinker. His writings connect accounts of qi and cosmic transformation with ethical responsibility.

people.name: Zhang Tong Zhenshi
people.role: 承受九皇眞經之道士
people.bio_en: Daoist figure described in the source as receiving a scripture of the Nine Sovereigns. Zhen ren is a religious honorific meaning Perfected One.

people.name: Zhang Shizhi
people.role: 漢廷尉，以可欲之說諫厚葬
people.bio_en: Han official known in received histories for judicial service. The indexed account presents his counsel against extravagant burial arrangements.

people.name: Cheng Tang
people.role: 商之開國君主，功烈光照
people.bio_en: Traditional founder of the Shang dynasty, also called Tang. Received accounts present his overthrow of Xia as a paradigm of dynastic change.

people.name: Qi Fujren
people.role: 漢高祖姬妾，遭呂后酷刑，變為人彘
people.bio_en: Consort of Emperor Gaozu of Han. Received histories recount her involvement in a succession dispute and her death under Empress Lü.

people.name: Bian Que
people.role: 戰國時良醫，與黃帝脈書並傳於倉公
people.bio_en: Famed physician in early Chinese medical tradition. Received accounts associate his name with diagnosis and the transmission of medical knowledge.

people.name: Bao Puzi
people.role: 葛洪之號，著內篇言神仙之道，以結綠玄黎需陶猗之市喻人才需明主
people.bio_en: Literary name of Ge Hong, author of the Baopuzi. His writings address religious cultivation, techniques of longevity, and social and political questions.

people.name: Zhuo Wenjun
people.role: 卓氏女，寡居聽琴私奔
people.bio_en: Woman associated in literary tradition with the Han writer Sima Xiangru. Their relationship is recounted through stories of music and courtship.

people.name: Hao Meng
people.role: 六朝時人，與了然子友善
people.bio_en: Figure named in the source's account of Liaoranzi. The headword and its identification require review; no further biographical details are established here.

people.name: Yi Ya
people.role: 齊桓公近臣，與豎刀、開方並用致禍
people.bio_en: Court figure associated with Duke Huan of Qi. Received anecdotes place him among favorites whose influence was criticized by later writers.

people.name: Zhu Xi
people.role: 宋儒，中和慎敬之說
people.bio_en: Song Confucian thinker and commentator. His works on the Four Books and moral cultivation strongly shaped later Confucian learning.

people.name: Liu Xiayan
people.role: 不羞污君，然其行不恭；與伯夷隘並稱
people.bio_en: Figure of early Chinese moral tradition, associated with Lu. Confucian discussions contrast his accommodation to circumstances with other models of integrity.

people.name: Huan Hui
people.role: 韓王，納地效忠
people.bio_en: Ruler of Han during the Warring States period. The indexed passage concerns political submission and the transfer of territory.

people.name: Yang Zhu
people.role: 戰國初期思想家，主張貴己為人人不損一毫
people.bio_en: Early Chinese thinker associated with concern for one's life and bodily integrity. His views survive chiefly through reports and debates in later texts.

people.name: Yang Xi
people.role: 一人耕而五人食，問田筴相員之效
people.bio_en: Speaker named in the indexed discussion of farming and population. The source supplies insufficient information for a secure identification with a known historical figure.

people.name: Lord Ye
people.role: 楚國君主，以楚人得弓為說
people.bio_en: Royal designation in an anecdote about a lost bow. The headword supplies the ruler's state but does not specify an individual reign.

people.name: King Xiang of Chu
people.role: 楚王，七國起兵之從者也
people.bio_en: Han prince associated with the Rebellion of the Seven States. The indexed passage identifies him among the princes who rose against the court.

people.name: Duke Xiao of Chu
people.role: 春秋時問鼎稱霸
people.bio_en: Ruler of Chu in the Spring and Autumn period. Received histories associate him with the expansion of Chu's influence among the states.

people.name: Luan Da
people.role: 漢武時方士，拜五利將軍，後以妄言被誅
people.bio_en: Religious specialist at the court of Emperor Wu of Han. Received histories describe his rapid promotion and later execution after his claims lost credibility.

people.name: Mao Bo
people.role: 周大夫，被王札子所殺
people.bio_en: Zhou aristocrat in the received historical tradition. The indexed passage concerns his killing in a conflict involving Wang Zha.

people.name: Wang Xiling
people.role: 三丰祖師全集序之作者，言隱見之道
people.bio_en: Writer of a preface to a collection attributed to Zhang Sanfeng. The preface discusses religious withdrawal and appearance in public life.

people.name: Liu Chang
people.role: 淮南厙王，驕奢致禍，絕食以死明志
people.bio_en: Han prince whose conflict with the imperial court is described in received histories. The indexed account uses his fate in a discussion of political conduct.

people.name: King Tang of Shang
people.role: 商朝開國之君
people.bio_en: Traditional founder of the Shang dynasty. Received accounts of his rule became examples in discussions of legitimate kingship.

people.name: Crown Prince of Teng
people.role: 滕國太子，居廬守喪五月
people.bio_en: Princely designation in a received account of mourning. The passage describes observance of rites following a parent's death.

people.name: Pan Anren
people.role: 晉代文人，工哀誄之文
people.bio_en: Western Jin writer known for poetry and commemorative prose. Anren is his courtesy name.

people.name: Yan Emperor
people.role: 神農氏，古帝之一
people.bio_en: Legendary sovereign of Chinese antiquity. Received traditions often associate him with Shennong and accounts of early civilization.

people.name: Wu Di
people.role: 假設之人，以言上林之廣大過實，故刪取要義以歸正道
people.bio_en: Fictional speaker in Han rhapsodic literature. His role concerns the description and criticism of imperial grandeur.

people.name: Yi
people.role: 古之富者，與陶並稱
people.bio_en: Abbreviated designation for a wealthy figure, paired with Tao in the indexed passage. A more specific personal identification is not established here.

people.name: Xuan Li
people.role: 美玉之名，需陶猗之市以成
people.bio_en: Name of a precious jade in the indexed passage. Its inclusion in the person index does not make it a historical individual.

people.name: Wang Fu Ren
people.role: 漢武帝后，問策於天子
people.bio_en: Court title in a Han anecdote. The source's description does not securely distinguish among women known by this title.

people.name: Wang Zha
people.role: 王子，以王命殺召伯毛伯
people.bio_en: Zhou royal figure in the received historical account. The indexed passage concerns orders for the killing of court aristocrats.

people.name: Wang Xizhi
people.role: 書法之聖
people.bio_en: Eastern Jin calligrapher. Later calligraphic tradition treats writings attributed to him as important models.

people.name: Minister of Justice
people.role: 五官之理，主司刑罰
people.bio_en: Official designation associated in the indexed passage with criminal justice. It denotes an office rather than a named person.

people.name: Gan Mao
people.role: 秦羈旅之臣，得秦重用而為向壽、公孫奭所讒
people.bio_en: Statesman who served Qin during the Warring States period. Received accounts discuss his diplomatic activity and conflicts at court.

people.name: Ning Ying
people.role: 衛國之士，以剛釋商書
people.bio_en: Figure associated with Wey in the received historical account. The indexed passage presents his interpretation of an early text.

people.name: Tian Heng's two guests
people.role: 田橫之客，從死以葬
people.bio_en: Two unnamed followers in the received account of Tian Heng. The narrative relates their deaths as an expression of loyalty after his death.

people.name: Lady Shen (of Shen)
people.role: 申國之君，厖王之舅
people.bio_en: Ruler of Shen in received Zhou tradition. The indexed account presents him as a royal relative and regional lord.

people.name: Lady Shen
people.role: 幽王正后，申侯之女
people.bio_en: Consort of King You of Zhou in received histories. Her displacement at court forms part of the traditional account of the fall of Western Zhou.

people.name: Wei Qing's son Deng
people.role: 衛青之子，與兄弟同日封侯
people.bio_en: Son of the Han general Wei Qing. The indexed passage records his enfeoffment alongside those of his brothers.

people.name: Baili Xi
people.role: 虞人，為秦穆公賢相，與伊尹皆聖人而以役身進
people.bio_en: Minister traditionally associated with Duke Mu of Qin. Received anecdotes discuss his rise from adverse circumstances to political service.

people.name: Yu
people.role: 夏禹，與伯夷、稷並稱三后，成功於民
people.bio_en: Legendary ruler associated with flood control and the founding of Xia. Received texts treat his labors as examples of service to the people.

people.name: King Zhao of Qin
people.role: 秦王，聽中期論知伯之戒
people.bio_en: Warring States ruler of Qin. The corpus includes a dialogue in which Zhong Qi uses an earlier political failure as a warning.

people.name: King Mu of Zhou
people.role: 周穆王，巡游涇上，密康公從之
people.bio_en: Zhou king prominent in received historical and literary traditions. The indexed passage concerns his travels and the ruler of Mi.

people.name: Dou Ying
people.role: 漢臣，佐景帝平七國之亂
people.bio_en: Han official associated with the reign of Emperor Jing. Received histories connect him with the response to the Rebellion of the Seven States.

people.name: King Zhou of Shang
people.role: 商末暴君，囚文王
people.bio_en: Last Shang ruler in received Chinese historical tradition. Later moral narratives present his conduct as an example of failed kingship.

people.name: Jie Lu
people.role: 美玉之名，需陶猗之市以成
people.bio_en: Name of a precious jade in the indexed passage. This is a literary object reference rather than an identified person.

people.name: Xian Men
people.role: 古之仙人，敬卒若始以致雲龍
people.bio_en: Figure associated with transcendents in Chinese religious tradition. The indexed passage uses his name in an account of sustained cultivation.

people.name: Laozi
people.role: 道家之祖，謂仁義憯然憤心，亂莫大焉
people.bio_en: Figure traditionally associated with the Tao Te Ching and the Daoist tradition. His historical identity and the formation of the text remain matters of scholarly discussion.

people.name: Jiu Fan
people.role: 晉臣，言一時之權者
people.bio_en: Adviser associated with Duke Wen of Jin. The indexed passage concerns the use of expedient measures in political affairs.

people.name: Xun Xi
people.role: 晉大夫，守諾至死不渝
people.bio_en: Jin official in the received historical tradition. Accounts of his death discuss loyalty to a promise and the consequences of court conflict.

people.name: King of Jing
people.role: 荊國之君
people.bio_en: Royal title using Jing as a designation for Chu. The index does not identify a particular ruler.

people.name: Duke Zhuang of Lu
people.role: 魯國之君
people.bio_en: Ruler of Lu in the Spring and Autumn period. He appears in the received historical accounts collected in this corpus.

people.name: Dong Zhongshu
people.role: 漢儒，下帷講誦，三年不觀於舍園，其精如此
people.bio_en: Han scholar associated with Confucian learning and the interpretation of the Spring and Autumn Annals. Received accounts emphasize his sustained commitment to study.

people.name: Chufu
people.role: 晉陽大夫，聘衛而過甯
people.bio_en: Jin official also indexed as Yang Chufu. The relevant historical anecdote concerns his journey as an envoy to Wey.

people.name: Wei Qing
people.role: 漢大將軍，征匈奴有功，三子同日受封
people.bio_en: Han general under Emperor Wu. Received histories recount his campaigns against the Xiongnu and the enfeoffment of his sons.

people.name: Lady Bao (Baosi)
people.role: 襃國女子，幽王寵妃
people.bio_en: Consort of King You of Zhou in received tradition. Narratives of the late Western Zhou associate her with disputes over the royal succession.

people.name: Xi Wangmu
people.role: 道家仙真之至象，壽若西王母
people.bio_en: Divine figure in Chinese mythology and Daoist religion. Her imagery is associated with longevity and the realm of transcendents.

people.name: Xu Xing
people.role: 滕文公時賢者，主君民並耕而食
people.bio_en: Thinker discussed in the Mencius in connection with Teng. He is portrayed as advocating that rulers work the fields alongside the people.

people.name: Xie Lingyun
people.role: 南朝宋詩人，與了然子友善
people.bio_en: Poet of the Southern Dynasties, especially associated with landscape poetry. The source also names him in a narrative about Liaoranzi.

people.name: Shu Dao
people.role: 齊桓公近臣，與易牙、開方並用致禍
people.bio_en: Name used in the source for a court favorite of Duke Huan of Qi. The indexed passage criticizes the influence of favorites after Guan Zhong's death.

people.name: Ben Huo
people.role: 古之勇士，千鈞之重需賁獲之抱
people.bio_en: Paired or contracted designation for strongmen in the indexed comparison. The headword does not securely identify a single individual.

people.name: Chi Huo
people.role: 神話人物，紫文金簡所載，與仲尼知靈寶相關
people.bio_en: Unresolved designation in a Daoist religious passage involving sacred writings. The source does not establish a secure personal identity or reading.

people.name: Zhao Xuanzi
people.role: 晉國正卿，趙氏之先
people.bio_en: Jin statesman, also called Zhao Dun. Received histories discuss his senior political office and his place in the Zhao lineage.

people.name: Zhao Dun
people.role: 晉正卿，使能佐中軍
people.bio_en: Jin statesman of the Spring and Autumn period, also called Zhao Xuanzi. Received accounts connect him with military command and court affairs.

people.name: Feng Youlan
people.role: 一民幾年之食，逢翁之問察歲儲虛實
people.bio_en: Speaker addressed as an elder in the indexed discussion of food reserves. The source does not support identification with a modern philosopher of a similar name.

people.name: Guo Pu
people.role: 晉代方術家，與了然子友善
people.bio_en: Jin writer and commentator associated with classical learning and divination. The source also names him in a Daoist hagiographic narrative.

people.name: Duke Zhuang of Zheng
people.role: 春秋初年小霸
people.bio_en: Ruler of Zheng during the early Spring and Autumn period. Received histories describe his role in conflicts among the Zhou states.

people.name: Chang Sang Jun
people.role: 古之禁方家，授上池之水與扁鵲，使其能透視病人臟腑
people.bio_en: Teacher in the received biography of the physician Bian Que. Reports of extraordinary perception belong to the narrative of medical transmission.

people.name: Kai Fang
people.role: 齊桓公近臣，與易牙、豎刀並用致禍
people.bio_en: Court figure associated with Duke Huan of Qi. The indexed anecdote groups him with favorites whose influence is criticized.

people.name: Duke Huai of Song
people.role: 宋國之君，為宋萬所弒
people.bio_en: Ruler of Song in the Spring and Autumn period. The received historical account connects his death with Song Wan.

people.name: Min Ziqian
people.role: 孔子弟子，以孝聞，以為仍用舊制，何必改作
people.bio_en: Disciple of Confucius, celebrated in the tradition for filial conduct. The Analects includes his advice about retaining an existing arrangement.

people.name: Yin Zi
people.role: 古之至道者，人退己進所以窮至道
people.bio_en: Teacher figure in the indexed philosophical passage. His reported saying concerns advancement in the pursuit of the Way.

people.name: Tao
people.role: 古之富者，結綠玄黎需陶猗之市
people.bio_en: Abbreviated designation for a wealthy figure, paired with Yi in the indexed passage. A more specific personal identification is not established here.

people.name: Lu Xiujing
people.role: 六朝道士，與了然子友善
people.bio_en: Daoist scholar and ritual organizer of the Southern Dynasties. The source also includes his name in a narrative about Liaoranzi.

people.name: Yang Chufu
people.role: 晉大夫，易中軍以為趙盾能
people.bio_en: Jin official in received historical tradition. The indexed passage concerns a change in military command involving Zhao Dun.

people.name: Ling Su
people.role: 古之善琴者，白雪之弦需靈素之徽
people.bio_en: Name or designation used in a comparison involving musical skill. The indexed passage alone does not establish a secure biographical identity.

people.name: Zhuan Xu
people.role: 高陽氏，古帝之一
people.bio_en: Legendary sovereign of Chinese antiquity, associated with the designation Gaoyang. Received genealogies place him among the ancient rulers.

people.name: Maiqiu Official
people.role: 齊麥丘之官，祝景公三事
people.bio_en: Unnamed local official in an anecdote concerning Duke Jing of Qi. The story records three wishes or admonitions addressed to the ruler.
Figure traditionally associated with the Daoist text Liezi. The received collection contains philosophical dialogues, parables, and accounts of cultivation.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as Bu Shang. The Analects associates him with learning, literature, and moral practice.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as Zhuansun Shi. The Analects preserves questions and sayings associated with him.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as Yan Yan. Received accounts connect him with ritual learning and administrative service.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as Duanmu Ci. Received texts portray him in discussions of moral conduct, diplomacy, and public affairs.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as Zhong You. The Analects presents him as forthright and interested in political service.
Chinese teacher associated with the Analects. His teachings and later interpretations became central to the Confucian tradition.
Confucian thinker of the Warring States period. The text bearing his name discusses moral cultivation, humane government, and human nature.
Adviser to Liu Bang during the founding of the Han dynasty. Received histories emphasize his role in political and military strategy.
Early Zhou king, traditionally the son of King Wu. Accounts of his reign are closely connected with the Duke of Zhou's regency.
Confucian figure also known as Zeng Shen. Received traditions associate him with filial conduct, self-examination, and the transmission of learning.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as You Ruo. The Analects attributes to him sayings on filial conduct and ritual harmony.
First emperor of the unified Qin empire. Received histories describe his conquests, administrative reforms, and imperial projects.
Adviser associated with King Goujian of Yue. Later traditions recount his withdrawal from office and activities as a merchant.
Early Chinese thinker traditionally associated with the Zhuangzi. The received text contains multiple layers of philosophical dialogue and imaginative narrative.
Statesman of the early Han. Received histories describe his strategic advice and participation in court government.
General who helped Liu Bang establish the Han dynasty. Received histories recount his military achievements and later conflict with the imperial court.
Warring States thinker associated with writings on law, political technique, and rulership. The collection bearing his name is central to the tradition often called Legalism.
Military leader during the collapse of Qin and the ensuing struggle for power. Received histories recount his conflict with Liu Bang.
Disciple of Confucius, also known as Yan Hui. The Analects presents him as a model of learning and moral cultivation.
